verdict.rationale: The SDK is explicitly built around an agent loop with built-in tools (file read/write/edit, run commands, web search), subagents for delegated subtasks, MCP integrations, and permission/hooks controls — this is the core mechanism for delegating tasks to Claude as an AI assistant inside the product. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of delegation quality/reliability beyond vendor docs, and clarity on how 'built-in assistant' persona differs from raw agent-loop primitives for non-technical AI-native users.
